claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings serve complementary roles only (citation heritage view, section cross-lingual view, linear hybrid complement). Primary navigation MUST use TF-IDF citation hybrids (JP ~0.71-0.78). True OOS jurist preference ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. 174k completion BLOCKED on corpus dependencies: bge_/bger_ ID mapping, parquet 2024-2026 (15,536 decisions), section extraction at 174k scale.
evidence_summary: All 9 critical findings independently verified against source evidence: (1) Citation heritage dense superiority CONFIRMED — center_projected AUC 0.767-0.85 > 0.75 at 21-24yr (137k-158k), raw_768dim fails at 24yr (AUC 0.68). (2) Section cross-lingual hierarchy CONFIRMED — Sachverhalt cp64 0.282 > 0.2 PASS, Dispositiv 0.150 > 0.1 PASS, Erwaegungen 0.094 < 0.1 FAIL; center projection improves invariance gaps. (3) Linear hybrid scale dependency CONFIRMED — optimal w=0.3-0.4 at 22yr PASS both adversarial gates (JP 0.61-0.67) but BELOW TF-IDF baseline (JP 0.71-0.78). (4) Two-mode tradeoff CONFIRMED — no single representation dominates LangDom/JP/CiteIndep at any scale. (5) Dense embeddings fail jurist gate ALL scales CONFIRMED (JP 0.05-0.43). (6) True OOS jurist pref ceiling ~0.53 CONFIRMED via v8 holdout (TF-IDF holdout JP 0.52-0.58 vs train 0.55-0.61). (7) Legal TF-IDF BGE corpus negative CONFIRMED — 6-8/14 PASS vs 14/14 baseline; corpus mismatch + signal deficits. (8) V18 coarse hierarchy negative CONFIRMED — best purity 0.65 < 0.7. (9) Orchestration failures diagnosed — bger_ corpus gaps, ID mapping, section extraction, mount path. Minor inaccuracy: progress.json does NOT flag 2022-2023 as failed (they are in completed_years). Lane correctly BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCIES with continue_recommended=false. Three complementary modes validated at minimal sufficient scales. Product integration contracts frozen. No further same-question cycles justified.
